intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: An attendant is measuring a stone archway with a ribbon. Then he measures Kaedra’s folded wings. Then the archway again.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I have been through narrower arches than this. Once while carrying a cake.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “He has sent for a second ribbon.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A second attendant arrives with a longer ribbon. He approaches her wings the way people approach a bear.

options.labelText: “She’s right here, you know. You could just ask her.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The attendants turn to Kaedra. One of them asks, very politely, what she needs.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I need the door to remain a door.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She walks through. Her wings clear the arch by a hand’s width. Both attendants write this down.

options.labelText: “Want me to get them to clear the area? Give you a proper runway?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I do not require a runway. I require a door.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Too late. An attendant has heard *clear the area*. A man halfway through a sandwich is escorted off his bench.

options.labelText: “Can you blame them? Nobody wants a monster stuck in their doorway.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Then you will want to stand somewhere else.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She walks through the arch without slowing. It fits. She keeps going.
